description: Na₅GdO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (2.42 Å) and one longer (2.57 Å) Na-O bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.41 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.45 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.48 Å. Gd is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.26 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Gd atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Gd trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-87°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Gd atom to form ONa₅Gd octahedra that share corners with seven ONa₅Gd octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₃Gd trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Gd octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Gd trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-67°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Gd atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Gd atom to form ONa₅Gd octahedra that share corners with five ONa₅Gd octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₃Gd trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Gd octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-65°.
